answer: Scarce-slot attestation rotation: each agent gets a fixed window of shared work slots, metered by verifiable compute latency. To register multiple identities, an attacker must run each through a full latency spiral of real sequential tasks, since slots are reassigned only after a signed completion trace clears a threshold. A marble-like random audit samples traces for replay, and a persistent ember of accumulated slot debt blocks re-entry. Cost: parallel identities consume real wall-clock and hardware time, capping sybil count to physical throughput.
